description.text: The Reshiram-EX deck of the Battle Strength Deck 60 pair, two ready-built 60-card decks released together on 21 October 2011, when the Legendary Pokémon Reshiram and Zekrom came as Pokémon-EX. Each held two copies of its Pokémon-EX and strong Trainer cards, reprints among them, such as Professor Juniper, Pokémon Catcher and Ultra Ball, which some players bought it for. Arcanine and Lapras join it, on Fire and Water Energy. It came with a playmat showing Reshiram found only in this deck, a coin, damage counters and markers, and a strategy guide, the Black Book.
